Ivo proposes **$42,500 for a guaranteed 50-day design engagement**. That brings the rate from $900 to $850 per day if Hearth commits to the full block and pays a 30% deposit within five business days of signing. Ivo can reserve the agreed dates when the deposit arrives.

- **Scope and revisions.** Ivo will develop the exhibit concept, visitor layout, accessible interpretation design, and final drawings and specifications for fabrication. The fee includes two rounds of revisions, one after concept review and one after design development. Hearth will provide one consolidated set of comments per round. Additional revisions require written approval at $900 per day.
- **Payments.** The deposit is $12,750. A further $17,000 is due at concept delivery and $12,750 at delivery of the final design package, each payable within ten business days.
- **Fabrication supervision.** Hearth can book supervision separately at $900 per day. Please flag any shop or installation dates now so Ivo can confirm availability before Hearth commits to them.
- **Portfolio use.** After the public opening, Ivo may show photographs of the exhibit in their portfolio and professional presentations, crediting Hearth and the photographer and using images cleared for those purposes.

If Hearth needs fewer than 50 guaranteed days, Ivo can price an agreed smaller block at the standard $900 day rate. Which block can Hearth commit to, when does the fabrication slot expire, and when does the fabricator need the final drawings? To settle scope against that deadline, please also identify the accessibility requirements and touring venue constraints the drawings must address.

Hearth Museum is eager to engage Ivo before our fabrication slot expires—we need to execute this agreement within the week so the fabricator can lock in our production window, with final drawings due in 10 weeks. 

Because this project is grant-funded, we have strict structural parameters on budget, cash flow, and deliverables. Here is a counterproposal that aligns Ivo’s day-rate structure with our grant requirements:

* **Days & Fee:** Hearth can commit to a **guaranteed 46-day block at $880/day ($40,480 total)**, which must include **44 design days and 2 on-site installation supervision days**. Additionally, we can cover a separate site travel allowance for those installation days outside the design fee. 
* **Payment Schedule:** Our accounting rules cap initial deposits at **20% ($8,096)** payable within 5 business days of signing. We propose paying the remaining 80% across three milestones (payable net-10): 30% ($12,144) at concept delivery, 30% ($12,144) at design development delivery, and 20% ($8,096) upon completion of the final package and the two installation days.
* **Scope, Accessibility & Touring Constraints:** Two consolidated revision rounds work well. Because this is an accessible traveling exhibit, the scope must meet ADA/universal design standards (wheelchair turning radii, tactile/braille integration, accessible reach and viewing heights) and include **one accessible alternate layout** so smaller or irregularly shaped touring venues can still maintain full accessibility. 
* **Deliverables & Rights:** To allow our team and touring partners to maintain and adapt the exhibit over its run, the final fabrication package must include **editable native design/fabrication files** alongside print-ready specs. 
* **Portfolio Embargo:** We are happy for Ivo to feature cleared, credited photos in their portfolio and presentations, provided we adjust the timing slightly: due to sponsor restrictions, photography cannot be shared publicly until the **first touring venue opens, two months after our initial launch**.

If we lock in the 10-week drawing deadline and confirm target installation dates for roughly 16 weeks out, how does this structure work for Ivo?

Ivo can commit to the **guaranteed 46-day block for $40,480** and deliver final drawings within 10 weeks of kickoff. We can sign this week if the agreement lists the 44 design days and two installation days separately, fixes the installation dates, and releases the design balance when Hearth receives the drawings.

**Fee and payment.** The design fee is $38,720. The two on-site installation supervision days total $1,760, with the site travel allowance paid separately. Ivo accepts the $8,096 deposit within five business days of signing and the two $12,144 payments at concept delivery and design development delivery. We propose splitting the last $8,096 into **$6,336 at final package delivery** and **$1,760 after the two installation days**, both on the same net-10 terms as the other milestones.

**Scope and schedule.** The design includes the primary layout and one accessible alternate layout for a smaller or irregular venue. Both will address the agreed ADA and universal design requirements, including wheelchair turning space, tactile and Braille interpretation, and accessible reach and viewing heights. To keep the 10-week deadline, Hearth would provide dimensioned plans or an agreed footprint for each layout at kickoff. We’ll set both review dates at signing, with one consolidated set of comments from Hearth at each review.

**Files and portfolio.** Ivo will deliver editable native design files for the final fabrication package alongside print-ready specifications. Hearth and its touring partners may use and adapt those files to fabricate, install, maintain, and tour this exhibit. Ivo accepts the portfolio embargo through the first touring opening. If that opening slips, we propose that Ivo may share cleared, credited photographs three months after Hearth’s public launch.

Can Hearth confirm the payment split and portfolio timing and provide the kickoff date and two firm installation dates around week 16? Ivo can then reserve those dates when the deposit arrives.

We are very close, and Hearth appreciates Ivo’s flexibility on the 46-day block, deliverables, and ADA/touring layouts. We just need to align two strict grant and sponsor rules, and we can lock in the exact dates to sign this week:

* **Three-Milestone Payment Rule:** Our grant administration restricts us to a 20% deposit plus **strictly three milestone disbursements**—we cannot split the final payment into four post-deposit invoices. However, so Ivo isn't waiting six weeks on the bulk of the final milestone, we can adjust the three milestone percentages to **30% ($12,144) at concept delivery, 35% ($14,168) at design development delivery, and 15% ($6,072) upon completion of the two installation days** (all net-10). Alternatively, if Ivo prefers to increase the total engagement fee slightly within our $41,400 ceiling to offset that 6-week wait on the final milestone—say, moving to the full $900/day rate ($41,400 total: $8,280 deposit, $12,420 at Concept, $14,490 at DD, and $6,210 after Installation, plus separate site travel)—Hearth is happy to approve that bump!
* **Portfolio Timing:** Because the photo embargo is tied to an external sponsor agreement, we unfortunately cannot authorize an automatic 3-month override if the touring venue is delayed—the embargo strictly holds until the **first touring venue opens** (currently contracted for two months post-launch). However, during any unexpected delay, Ivo may show cleared, credited photos privately in 1-on-1 client pitches, with public online/portfolio posting unlocked the day the touring venue opens.
* **Firm Schedule & Kickoff Inputs:** Hearth will deliver dimensioned plans for the primary space and the agreed footprint for the accessible alternate layout at kickoff. Assuming we sign by Thursday, we propose:
  * **Kickoff:** Next Monday (Week 1)
  * **Concept Review:** End of Week 3 (Hearth returns consolidated comments within 3 business days)
  * **Design Development Review:** End of Week 7 (consolidated comments within 3 business days)
  * **Final Fabrication Package & Editable Files Due:** Friday of Week 10
  * **Two Firm On-Site Installation Days:** Thursday and Friday of Week 16 (with a capped or pre-approved site travel allowance billed separately).

Does Ivo prefer the $900/day rate ($41,400 total) under that 20% / 30% / 35% / 15% three-milestone schedule, and can Ivo confirm those Week 1 through Week 16 dates and the sponsor photo terms?

Ivo accepts **$41,400 for 46 guaranteed days at $900 per day**. The agreement will list 44 design days ($39,600) and two on-site installation supervision days ($1,800). Hearth will cover pre-approved site travel separately.

Ivo confirms the following dates for signature by **Thursday, November 26, 2026**.

| Date | Commitment | Payment |
|---|---|---|
| November 26, 2026 | Sign agreement | $8,280 deposit within five business days |
| November 30, 2026 | Kickoff. Hearth provides dimensioned plans for the primary space and the agreed alternate footprint. | |
| December 18, 2026 | Concept delivery and review | $12,420, net 10 |
| January 15, 2027 | Design development delivery and review | $14,490, net 10 |
| February 5, 2027 | Final fabrication package, including editable native files and print-ready specifications for the primary and accessible alternate layouts | |
| March 18–19, 2027 | Two on-site installation supervision days | $6,210 after the second day, net 10 |

The fee includes two revision rounds. Hearth will return consolidated comments within three business days of each review. The agreed accessibility requirements and Hearth’s and its touring partners’ rights to use and adapt the files for this exhibit apply to both layouts.

Ivo accepts the sponsor terms. Public use of cleared, credited photographs in Ivo’s portfolio and presentations may begin the day the first touring venue opens. If that opening is delayed, Ivo may show those photographs privately in one-on-one client pitches during the delay.

Please send the agreement on these terms for signature Thursday.

Hearth confirms all agreed terms, deliverables, rights, and dates, with one minor scheduling catch: Thursday, November 26, 2026 is Thanksgiving in the US, when our administrative offices are closed. We will send the finalized agreement over for signature by **Wednesday, November 25, 2026**, keeping the exact same kickoff, review, delivery, installation, and payment schedule intact (with additional revisions beyond the two included rounds requiring written approval at $900/day, as originally proposed). 

Please confirm Wednesday, November 25 works for execution and we will issue the contract right away.

Ivo confirms availability to sign on **Wednesday, November 25, 2026**, and accepts the agreed terms, including written approval for additional revisions at $900 per day. Please issue the agreement for signature.
